hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -q '\.rs"' && cargo fmt --all --quiet 2>/dev/null; exit 0

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; echo '🧭 Helix 开局：① 读 docs/ROADMAP.md §二 P0 活账（当前阻塞）② 触发速查 docs/harness/OPERATING.md（什么事→调什么）③ 闸门 scripts/gate.sh · 验收 /helix-acceptance · 文档对账 /helix-drift-check'; OPEN=$(awk 'BEGIN{p=0} /^\*\*P0（M2 收官阻塞）\*\*/{p=1; next} /^\*\*P1（/{p=0} p && /^- \[ \]/{print}' docs/ROADMAP.md 2>/dev/null | head -6); [ -n "$OPEN" ] && printf '── 未完 P0（仅 P0 段）──\n%s\n' "$OPEN"; exit 0

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); RS=$(printf '%s' "$DIRTY" | grep -cE '\.rs$' || true); DOC=$(printf '%s' "$DIRTY" | grep -cE '\.md$' || true); MSG=''; [ "${RS:-0}" -gt 0 ] && MSG="$MSG⚠️ 未提交 .rs($RS)—commit/push 前 scripts/gate.sh 先验。 "; [ "${DOC:-0}" -gt 0 ] && MSG="$MSG📄 未提交 .md($DOC)—状态变更跑 /helix-drift-check + 查 harness 索引不变量。"; [ -n "$MSG" ] && echo "$MSG"; exit 0
